vat_rates.legal_product_description: Standard rate of Value-Added Tax on the supply of goods and services by taxable persons, and on the importation of goods.
vat_rates.normalized_product_description: standard rate of value-added tax on the supply of goods and services by taxable persons, and on the importation of goods.
vat_rates.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2013 (Act 870), Section 3, "Rate of the tax": "Except as otherwise provided in this Act, the rate of the tax is fifteen percent and is calculated on the value of the taxable supply of goods and services or import." Commencement date (31 December 2013) is not printed in the GRA PDF text itself; corroborated by GhaLII's Akoma Ntoso citation (eng@2013-12-31), not independently verified against the Gazette.
